title: Career Roadmap · Housekeeping Supervisor
summary: A Housekeeping Supervisor manages room-cleaning teams, cleanliness standards, linen and supplies, inspections, staff schedules and guest requests in hotels and other accommodation facilities.

about.label: Common pathway
about.text: Class 10/12 → Hotel Management / Housekeeping training → hotel practical experience → Room Attendant → Housekeeping Supervisor.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Any stream; verify course-specific eligibility.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: English, basic mathematics, communication and computer applications.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Room preparation, sanitation, laundry, inventory and hotel operations.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Attention to detail, teamwork, time management, safe chemical handling and guest service.

items.text: Diploma in Housekeeping Operations → Directly relevant room and public-area operations.
Diploma in Hotel Management / Catering Technology → Broader hotel operations.
Diploma / certificate in Accommodation Operations → Room servicing and housekeeping procedures.
B.Sc. Hospitality & Hotel Administration → Housekeeping and wider hotel management careers.

blocks.text: Entrance requirements vary by institution. Verify the current official admission notification.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Cleaning standards, room setup, sanitation, linen and guest etiquette.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Room inspections, inventory, staff allocation, laundry coordination and industrial training.

blocks.label: Year 3 / work experience
blocks.text: Quality audits, shift planning, cost control and team supervision.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Room-inspection checklist; linen inventory tracker; housekeeping duty roster; sustainable cleaning and waste-reduction plan.

blocks.label: Hotels / resorts
blocks.text: Room attendant, public-area housekeeping, laundry and housekeeping coordination.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Hotel chains, serviced apartments, resorts, facility-management companies.

blocks.label: Potential employers
blocks.text: Taj Hotels, ITC Hotels, Marriott, Hilton and Hyatt; check their official career portals.

blocks.label: Ideal areas
blocks.text: Room operations, quality inspection, linen control and housekeeping stores.
Internship and vacancy availability varies; placements are not guaranteed.

blocks.label: Alternative
blocks.text: Diploma → B.Sc. Hospitality & Hotel Administration → wider hotel operations roles.

blocks.label: Specialized
blocks.text: Housekeeping → laundry management, public-area operations or facilities coordination.
Relevant programmes

items.text: Post Graduate Diploma in Accommodation Operations & Management.

items.text: Work experience only where the programme requires it.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Room Attendant, Housekeeping Supervisor, Public Area Supervisor, Assistant Executive Housekeeper.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Hotels, resorts, cruise operators, serviced residences and facility management.

items.text: Direct hiring may be possible, but depends on experience, employer requirements and local work rules. Sponsorship is not guaranteed.

blocks.text: Housekeeping Trainee ↓ Room Attendant ↓ Senior Room Attendant ↓ Housekeeping Supervisor ↓ Assistant Executive Housekeeper ↓ Executive Housekeeper / Rooms Division Manager
